4574-6900-7435-8095--44.description:
Sacrifice the templated artifact.
Resolve the ability of your sacrifice outlet.
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Arcbound Reclaimer, putting the artifact on top of your library.
Your leaves-the-graveyard effect triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Cast the templated artifact for 0 life through Gwenom.
Repeat.
4574-6900-7435-8095--44.notes:
This combo will only result in creature ETB/LTB/etc. if the chosen card from the template is an artifact creature, in which case creature-specific sacrifice outlets may also be used.
For artifacts from the template that can sacrifice themselves, the free sacrifice outlet is unnecessary.

When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.

585-4881-6909-7884.manaNeeded: {2}{W}{U} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
585-4881-6909-7884.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Carnage to become a Merfolk until end of turn
Cast Sygg's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 4, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 6.

728-1495-2060-5544-6431.manaNeeded: {B} if Crystalline Crawler does not have a +1/+1 counter on it
728-1495-2060-5544-6431.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Forsaken Miner.
If able, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Forsaken Miner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Forsaken Miner enters the battlefield, Celes's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Triskelion ability from step 3.
Repeat.

Activate Evereth by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Proper Burial and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat.
1981-2324-2415-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

670-804-1619-3668.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Flesh Duplicate and Sakashima the Impostor each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Flesh Duplicate trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-804-1619-3668.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Brass Infiniscope.

If you wish to use these abilities, you'll want to stop the combo before getting too many triggers such that you'll deck yourself and lose the game. To gain life, you must spend at least {2} for X when casting the spell.

Repeat.
